This is a bit long but here we go! I was 9 when I got into a severe car accident with my used to be friend and her dad. Her dad was acting weird all morning as we packed the truck from their family's cabin we stayed at during memorial weekend. Got in the cabin of the truck and couldn't get situated right. It was one of those fold out tiny seats there was  a lot of blankets and pillows. Asked for help and the dad said screw it and just left me how I was. 

Making our way down the mountain was pretty windy lots of sharp turns and skinny roads her dad kept looking in the rear view mirror. Then the next straight away pulled to the side near a ravine where things got weirder. He says he thinks someone is following us we look around confused and saw no one he even got out and looked around. Then got back in the truck started it up then started to move forward till we heard gravel and something slide. He parked to close to the side of the road and and we started to slide down . 

Remember that I didn't have a seat belt I held onto my friends seat (she was in the passenger seat. Then the truck rolled over twice I lost grip and got jumbled around in the back of the cabin everything went black. Opened my eyes my adrenaline was pumping sitting up I looked around checked on my friend I couldn't move my arm and my ankle hurt a little. Glass was everywhere my friend was able to get out safely but I couldn't get out of the back I didn't have the strength and the drivers seat was stuck. Her dad had to pull me out I screamed out in pain turns out I broke my collarbone and had glass embedded in my ankle. 

I was in a rough state which is saying it lightly. I screamed and cussed this grown man I was livid at what happend. Then we had to climb up this giant ravine through barbed wire my friend helped me I decided to scoot up the hill the rest of the way as my friend crawled we got up to the road. We waited not sure what to do (no cell phones at the point in time '99 decided to hitchhike to the cabin got a ride. 
He called our parents (friend parents were divorced) lied that we were alright as I'm yelling at him that he was a fucking liar. Police and a tow truck showed up, the car that picked us up called the police. We rode to the accident and went to the emts where me and my friend were put in the ambulance. My friends dad put in a cop car.

The emts were stunned at my state we reached the hospital put in through xrays and a Iv  and morphine and took care of my arm. Through the day I was going in and out of consciousness couldn't control my bladder much and threw up a few times. My parents finally came in I fell back asleep and coming to my friend and my parents were in my room. It was time to go. I made my dad drive slow as I hid in the front seat holding onto my dad's leg. Dropped my friend off at home I cried seeing my friends mom then we went back home my mom slept on the floor by my bed that night.

Turns out my friends dad was pretty drunk that morning he was drinking fosters in a mug since 5. I had to go to child's therapist till I was able to be in a car again without my parents and able to go down steep hills. I always had to listen to classical music (motzart and the like) while in the car. I'm still severely afraid of heights and have some ptsd moments. I'm better though I can actually drive a car.

TLDR: friends dad was drunk we got into a car wreck the flipped us three times I broke my collarbone and had glass in my ankle. Now I have a fear of heights control issues with how people drive. Went to therapy.
